sentences.en: The long commute every day was dispiriting.
sentences.zh: 每天长途通勤令人沮丧。

sentences.en: Seeing the company lay off so many people is a dispiriting experience.
sentences.zh: 看到公司裁员这么多员工真是让人气馁。

sentences.en: The endless traffic jams are dispiriting for anyone who drives to work.
sentences.zh: 无休止的交通堵塞让开车上下班的人很沮丧。

senses.zh: 令人沮丧的， 使人气馁的
